question: India launched a commemorative logo to mark her 30th anniversary of diplomatic ties with which of these countries?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Israel**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India launched a commemorative logo to mark her 30th anniversary of diplomatic ties with **Israel**.
 
• The logo was unveiled in a virtual ceremony attended by the ambassadors of both countries.
 
• The logo features the **Star of David and the Ashoka Chakra**, symbolizing the strong friendship and deep-rooted ties between the two nations.
 
• India and Israel established full diplomatic relations on **January 29, 1992**, and have since developed a multi-faceted partnership across various sectors including defense, agriculture, and technology.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India was among the 164 nations that voted in favor of the UN resolution for the partition of Palestine and the **creation of Israel in 1947**.
 
• Despite early support, India did not establish full diplomatic relations with Israel until 1992.
 
• Since the establishment of full diplomatic ties, India and Israel have significantly expanded cooperation in areas such as defense, agriculture, water management, and cybersecurity.
 
• The two countries have also increased people-to-people contacts through cultural exchanges and tourism.
 
• India is one of Israel's largest trading partners in Asia, and both countries continue to explore new avenues for collaboration.
